name: qfd_xs_leaf-xl2-adf2fc2cb
purpose: Qwen TP8 compute die distributed x slice LEAF (owner 08:20 PT 10-14): 2 tiles x 2 epochs x 2 aligned 64-element beats of BF16 operands (RNE-rounded at the tap) + per-element valid; write chain pin-registered pass-through, 4-element window read (explicit 512:1 trees), answer pin flops. One clock root (~10.1k sinks). xl2: outline 108 x 211.68 (gate xl1 08:29: util 85 % at 108 x 129.6), read-select pin registers replicated per tree level (<= 256 mux loads per copy; xl1 select flops drove ~8,600 loads).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qfd_xs_leaf #(.NCH(4)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/dvm_20261014/ot_qfd_xslice.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_xs_leaf/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_xs_leaf/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_xs_leaf --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qfd_xs_leaf  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
